terms.Rumor: Spreading a rumor at Kuzunoha Detective Agency (human rumors) or via Pact demons (demon rumors) makes it become reality in Sumaru City.
terms.Fusion Spell: Casting specific element or skill types consecutively in a single round triggers a combo spell. Killing the last foe with one boosts +2 Rank Up and Mutation odds.
terms.Contact: Negotiating with demons in battle. Raise Eager 3x for Tarot Cards, or raise Happy 3x to form a Pact.
terms.Eager: Yellow emotion meter. Raising Eager 3x ends the fight peacefully and awards Tarot Cards matching the demon's Arcana.
terms.Pact: Formed by raising Happy 3x. Encountering that demon again lets you ask for money, items, Free Cards, or demon rumors.
terms.Estoma: Field/Persona spell (e.g. Nemesis Lv. 24, Umayadono-Ouji Lv. 23) that prevents random encounters with lower-level demons.
terms.Free Card: Blank Tarot Card earned from Pact demons when raising Eager; convertible to any Arcana at the Velvet Room Painter.
terms.Prime Persona: Mid-game upgraded Persona granted by Philemon in Chapter 3 if you trust your party members in key Chapter 1–3 dialogues.
terms.Dx: Dexterity — the highest-priority stat in Persona 2 (governs magic/Fusion Spell damage). Raise to 60–80 first.
